title: Cad Bane
description: Notorious bounty hunter Cad Bane terrorized the galaxy for years. Working for the Pyke Syndicate, he warned Cobb Vanth to avoid the dispute between his bosses and Boba Fett. When Vanth was unmoved, Bane blasted him. At the Battle of Mos Espa, Bane confronted Boba Fett. Fett put down the bounty hunter with his Gaderffii stick.
